about: Player XP, skill points, monster XP, and Paragon. Tuning lives here, not in code. The level curve is unchanged: XP from L to L+1 is floor(a L^2 + b L). A normal full campaign clear should end at about level 50 after monsterXpMul. No skill synergies.
notes: At level 50 you have 100 skill points (2 at level 1, then +2 each level-up). With skillMaxRank 20 that is five skills maxed. Old saves keep their level and receive the missing skill points once on load (one extra point per level, including the +1 at level 1).

paragon.about: After level 50, leftover XP becomes Paragon XP. Hard cap is 100. Each Paragon level grants 5 spendable stat points (500 at the cap) and, every 5th level, 1 skill point (20 by Paragon 100). Automatic +2 maximum life per Paragon level (a regular passive, not a spell). +1% move speed every 10th Paragon level, applied after gear FRW has already been capped at 80%. Paragon never unlocks spell books.
